title: 大阪杯の後に・自然発生

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon shocks the crowd with her display of potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her legs in good shape, she's gained full confidence in her ability to run through the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon goes on to make advancements in her body modification research while preparing for her next race—the Takarazuka Kinen.
